description: Decision-record conformance vectors for the Corpus decision registry (docs/decisions.md in kontourai/corpus). Each vector is a whole registry: records keyed by filename slug, with the file text, the frontmatter as JSON (null when the block cannot be read), and the expected rule codes (empty means valid). Index freshness and the ADR freeze are repository checks and are not covered here.
